rationale: The low-of-day breakdown thesis has failed as buyers stepped in with a 69,968-share 1-minute volume surge—more than 15x the volume of preceding bars—driving price from $35.07 back above the 5m 9-EMA ($35.42). With the tight consolidation resolving upward on heavy volume and the bid-ask spread widening to 76.2 bps, closing immediately exits the failed setup before a deeper squeeze toward VWAP.
